question: Whose team depended on him more in 2015-16: Curry or LeBron?
answer:
# On-Court Impact Review

## Answer

**My judgement: I lean toward Stephen Curry.**

A bounded criterion fallback is used because the generated interpretation did not pass review.

**Criterion:** A conditional regular season preference prioritizing observed on-minus-off team net rating. This is a disclosed narrow lens, not a complete player ranking.

**Decisive reason:** Stephen Curry leads the selected primary measure in the matched phase. This establishes the preference only under the stated lens. [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=201939&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/teamplayeronoffsummary?TeamID=1610612744&LastNGames=0&MeasureType=Base&Month=0&OpponentTeamID=0&PaceAdjust=N&PerMode=Totals&Period=0&PlusMinus=N&Rank=N&Season=2015-16&SeasonType=Regular+Season&DateFrom=&DateTo=&GameSegment=&LeagueID=00&Location=&Outcome=&SeasonSegment=&VsConference=&VsDivision=) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=2544&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/teamplayeronoffsummary?TeamID=1610612739&LastNGames=0&MeasureType=Base&Month=0&OpponentTeamID=0&PaceAdjust=N&PerMode=Totals&Period=0&PlusMinus=N&Rank=N&Season=2015-16&SeasonType=Regular+Season&DateFrom=&DateTo=&GameSegment=&LeagueID=00&Location=&Outcome=&SeasonSegment=&VsConference=&VsDivision=)

**Strongest counterargument:** The other player leads the linked alternative measures or phases; those advantages prevent an unconditional ranking. [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=201939&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/teamplayeronoffsummary?TeamID=1610612744&LastNGames=0&MeasureType=Base&Month=0&OpponentTeamID=0&PaceAdjust=N&PerMode=Totals&Period=0&PlusMinus=N&Rank=N&Season=2015-16&SeasonType=Playoffs&DateFrom=&DateTo=&GameSegment=&LeagueID=00&Location=&Outcome=&SeasonSegment=&VsConference=&VsDivision=) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=2544&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/teamplayeronoffsummary?TeamID=1610612739&LastNGames=0&MeasureType=Base&Month=0&OpponentTeamID=0&PaceAdjust=N&PerMode=Totals&Period=0&PlusMinus=N&Rank=N&Season=2015-16&SeasonType=Playoffs&DateFrom=&DateTo=&GameSegment=&LeagueID=00&Location=&Outcome=&SeasonSegment=&VsConference=&VsDivision=)

**Why this judgement:** The primary criterion takes precedence for this conditional choice; the evidence does not establish that everyone should adopt that priority.

**What could change it:** Giving more weight to LeBron James's advantages in On-minus-off net rating in Playoffs could reverse this preference. Additional comparable evidence favoring LeBron James on the requested contributions could also change this judgement.

## Dimension findings

- **Team on/off context:** Regular Season: Stephen Curry has the higher on-minus-off net rating; Playoffs: LeBron James has the higher on-minus-off net rating. This describes team association, not an isolated player effect.

This position compares observed contributions, not innate ability. Team on/off is association rather than causation.

**Scope:** 2015-16–2015-16 versus 2015-16–2015-16; Regular Season, Playoffs.

## Key evidence

- **Team on/off context / Regular Season:** Stephen Curry (2015 / Golden State Warriors): On-minus-off net rating **23.1** points / 100 possessions, ON min **2,700** minutes, OFF min **1,276** minutes; LeBron James (2015 / Cleveland Cavaliers): On-minus-off net rating **16.1** points / 100 possessions, ON min **2,709** minutes, OFF min **1,262** minutes. [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=201939&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/teamplayeronoffsummary?TeamID=1610612744&LastNGames=0&MeasureType=Base&Month=0&OpponentTeamID=0&PaceAdjust=N&PerMode=Totals&Period=0&PlusMinus=N&Rank=N&Season=2015-16&SeasonType=Regular+Season&DateFrom=&DateTo=&GameSegment=&LeagueID=00&Location=&Outcome=&SeasonSegment=&VsConference=&VsDivision=) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/playercareerstats?PlayerID=2544&PerMode=Totals&LeagueID=00) [Evidence](https://stats.nba.com/stats/teamplayeronoffsummary?TeamID=1610612739&LastNGames=0&MeasureType=Base&Month=0&OpponentTeamID=0&PaceAdjust=N&PerMode=Totals&Period=0&PlusMinus=N&Rank=N&Season=2015-16&SeasonType=Regular+Season&DateFrom=&DateTo=&GameSegment=&LeagueID=00&Location=&Outcome=&SeasonSegment=&VsConference=&VsDivision=)

## Coverage and limits

- Historical box-score evidence is not equivalent to modern tracking or lineup data. Missing historical coverage does not count against a player.
- Steals, blocks and rebounds describe recorded activity; matchup difficulty, positioning, deterrence and defensive schemes are not measured here.
- On/off comparisons are confounded by lineup, opponent and substitution choices. No causal team/winning impact is established.
- Small or unequal appearance samples and stale API responses remain limitations. No synthetic overall impact score is used.
